caption:
You are 13.8 billion years old, one atom at a time. The hydrogen in you came from the Big Bang. The iron in your blood came from exploding stars.

Save this and say one line to yourself tomorrow morning.

Link in bio.
by NMR
#affirmations #stardust #universe #naos
fuente_cifras: NASA, age of the universe 13.8 billion years (https://science.nasa.gov/universe/overview/, read 2026-11-17); Johnson, J. A. (2019) 'Populating the periodic table: Nucleosynthesis of the elements', Science 363:474-478, doi:10.1126/science.aau9540

alt.1: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes looking up. The slide reads: You are 13.8 billion years old.
alt.2: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Hydrogen · the Big Bang Hydrogen I am older than my name. Made in the first minutes of the universe. Some of it is in you.
alt.3: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Carbon · inside stars Carbon I am built from slow starlight. Cooked in stars, then let go as they aged. It is in every cell you have.
alt.4: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Oxygen · massive stars Oxygen I breathe what the stars left me. Made in massive stars and flung out when they ended. You breathed some in just now.
alt.5: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Calcium · stars Calcium I stand on old fire. Your teeth and bones hold calcium that stars made.
alt.6: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Iron · exploding stars Iron I have been through bigger explosions than this. The iron in your blood was made in stars that exploded.
alt.7: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Atoms · older than Earth Atoms I am an old guest with a new morning. Nearly every atom in you is older than the Earth.
alt.8: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: You · right now Now I am exactly on time. All of it, put together, reading this.
alt.9: Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars, eyes turned up and toward the text. The slide reads: Say one tomorrow. I am older than my name. I am built from slow starlight. I breathe what the stars left me. I stand on old fire. I have seen bigger bangs than this. I am an old guest with a new morning. I am exactly on time. Save this. Say one tomorrow morning.
